previous_statement: After nodes 1.2, 1.3, 1.4.1, and 1.4.2 are validated, their combination proves this bridge: 1.4.2 supplies the base a_1>=r_+; 1.4.1 supplies r_+/2>1/8>r_- and r_+>=1-C_diag e; and 1.2 plus 1.3 show that a_{2^k}>=r_+ implies a_{2^{k+1}}>r_- and hence, by the quadratic dichotomy, a_{2^{k+1}}>=r_+. Induction gives the dyadic bounds, and the size monotonicity from 1.3 transfers them to every n.

Induction gives the dyadic bounds, and the size monotonicity from 1.3 transfers them to every n.
